name: tool_search
description: Find Wylde tools by natural-language description. Scores the in-process tool catalog (descriptions, tags, ids) and returns the best matches. Use this mid-workflow when an agent needs a tool not declared up-front.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-form description of what the agent needs.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Optional filter: only return tools whose 'service' field matches.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Optional filter: only return tools whose 'tags' include this value.
